## What changed

Describe the user-visible or developer-facing change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant automated tests were added or updated.
- [ ] `.\scripts\check-phase2.ps1 -Configuration Release` passes on Windows, or the reason it could not run is documented.
- [ ] Self-hosted changes were exercised with the Compose smoke/restore workflow.
- [ ] Documentation and examples were updated where needed.

## Security and privacy

- [ ] No credentials, private targets, certificates, tokens, local databases, or unredacted evidence are included.
- [ ] RDP password handling remains prompt-only.
- [ ] Authorization, import, synchronization, export, audit, and support-data boundaries were considered where applicable.

## Contribution

- [ ] Every commit includes a `Signed-off-by` line (`git commit --signoff`).
